title: Pattern match engine (src/constraints/patterns.rs) + finding location fields
description:
New module src/constraints/patterns.rs: given a compiled forbidden_pattern constraint and a set of files (scope-matched), parse each file with the language grammar, run the query, and produce matches with { file, line, byte_range, snippet, enclosing_symbol_qualified_name }. Enclosing-symbol resolution maps match byte offset → symbol range (reuse the existing extraction machinery — needed for symbol-level waiver matching downstream).

Also extend ConstraintViolation (review.rs) and ConstraintFinding (guard.rs) with optional location fields (line, snippet) rather than overloading the detail string. Keep from_path/to_path semantics for dep kinds untouched — refactor-contract discipline applies (lessons ledger L9: diff behavioral contract of every caller).

Skip files whose language doesn't match the constraint's language. Only parse files matching scope. No DD involvement — this is a per-file local pass (precedent: external.rs).

Design: sutra/221 implementation_plan. Unit tests in patterns.rs with inline source fixtures (rust + dart).
execution_record: Two commits: b5bca7a (main implementation) and d0d5993 (dead code cleanup). tree-sitter 0.25 uses StreamingIterator for QueryMatches, not std Iterator — required adding streaming-iterator as a direct dep. Enclosing symbol resolution reuses adapter parse + flatten_symbols rather than DB lookup, keeping the engine self-contained for the per-file local pass. 9 tests covering: rust/dart matches, scope filtering, language filtering, enclosing symbol resolution, identity propagation, no-match empty case, non-pattern constraint passthrough. Extended ConstraintFinding with 3 optional fields; updated 10 construction sites across check.rs, external.rs, guard.rs, and review-test.rs.

messages.author: agent
messages.text: Review: approve with notes. Codex adversarial review confirmed the engine is correct in isolation. Two integration findings are out-of-scope (sutra/242 wires evaluate, sutra/243 handles guard enforcement). Codex specifically flagged: (1) find_waiver in waivers.rs currently only matches file-level waivers (symbol_qualified_name=None), so the enclosing_symbol field added here can't participate in waiver matching until that code is updated — sutra/243 should account for this. (2) Double parse per file (tree-sitter for query, ParserPool for symbol extraction) — a potential optimization point if pattern checks are hot. Refactor-contract discipline verified: from_path/to_path semantics unchanged, new fields are purely additive Option<T> with None defaults, JSON output conditional on presence."
